title: Simplify post-Yes result view to text-only message

requirements.summary: Replace the post-Yes result UI with a simple text-only message and ensure no meme image is rendered.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the “Yes! 💖” button switches from the question/options view to a result view.
The result view displays the exact message text: “Found me jiyuu ❤️ , By the way good choice 😘”.
The result view does not render any meme image (i.e., no for /assets/generated/valentine-meme.dim_1200x1200.png).
The “No” evasive behavior and the initial Valentine prompt remain unchanged.

file_operations.description: Update the answered=true render branch to be text-only: remove the meme (and any references to frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-meme.dim_1200x1200.png) and simplify the result layout so it shows only the exact message “Found me jiyuu ❤️ , By the way good choice 😘”, while leaving the initial prompt view and the evasive “No” button behavior unchanged.
